notes.title: Artists & New Animations
notes.content:
[h3]Hey friends,

A major update came out today, we added [b]2 Amazing Full HD animations[/b]!

You can find it in the [b]following levels[/b]:

- [b]The first level of the Puzzle[/b]

- [b]The third level of the "Catch the Furry!"[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38027795/ea541279bad194e3a0b1e6359a9d3236b3b0a7e9.png[/img]

You can see and rate them in [b]the gallery[/b] or in [b]the game modes[/b]. Write your opinion about the animations, like it or not, it will be very interesting for us to read :)

Also some bugs that you reported to us have been fixed. [b]Thanks for the help![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38027795/27e53dea08c2eb250a7ddf5fd0754024b2469d1f.png[/img]
